about: Pure-Ergo mutant anchor, derived generator, planner, and verdict reporter (DoD floor).

mutants.name: selfhost-mutants-store-reset-ints
mutants.rule: ResetScratch must truncate scratch int stack cursor back to zero

mutants.name: selfhost-mutants-checktext-blank-gap
mutants.rule: Only two or more newlines create a blank-line gap separator in CheckText

mutants.name: selfhost-mutants-anchor-3way-parse
mutants.rule: 3-way anchor verification must reject parse failures on mutated .ergo output

mutants.name: selfhost-mutants-anchor-go-recv
mutants.rule: Go receiver type extraction must strip generic type arguments before whitespace splitting

mutants.name: selfhost-mutants-ledger-unknown-field
mutants.rule: Strict ledger parsing must refuse unrecognized JSON root keys

mutants.name: selfhost-mutants-ledger-duplicate-row
mutants.rule: Ledger validation must reject duplicate mutant row names

mutants.name: selfhost-mutants-derive-cmp-swap
mutants.rule: cmp-swap derived operator must mutate less-than comparisons to <=

mutants.name: selfhost-mutants-derive-strict-law
mutants.rule: Derived strict check must report surviving derived mutants inside law declarations

mutants.name: selfhost-mutants-plan-test-prefix
mutants.rule: Killer parser must reject explicit DIR:test:Name prefixes

mutants.name: selfhost-mutants-plan-test-before-law
mutants.rule: ReachingObligations must schedule tests before laws

mutants.name: selfhost-mutants-report-timeout-unjudged
mutants.rule: Timed-out obligation attempts must never count as mutant kills

mutants.name: selfhost-mutants-report-unique-singleton
mutants.from: let uniq = if actual.Len() == 1 { actual[0] } else { "" }
mutants.rule: UniqueKiller must only be recorded when a single killer caught the mutant

mutants.name: selfhost-mutants-report-strict-ok
mutants.from: handSurvived == 0 && handInvalid == 0 && handUnjudged == 0 && dSurvived == 0 && dLawSurvived == 0 && dInvalid == 0 && dUnjudged == 0
mutants.to: handSurvived == 0 && handInvalid == 0 && handUnjudged == 0 && dLawSurvived == 0 && dInvalid == 0 && dUnjudged == 0
mutants.rule: Strict report mode must fail when any non-law derived mutant survives
